Page.Name: page.custom.canvas
Page.Title: Canvas
Page.Subtitle: Raven has no <canvas> element; its CUSTOM widget is one. A paint callback draws with Rdraw_rect, _circle, _line, _curve, _triangle, _text, _image and _glass, clipped, in logical units; Rdraw_spring animates. Raven also has a Canvas panel, which places widgets (not pixels) freely with anchors. src/canvas_demo.c makes the two tags below.

Demo.Title: <CanvasShowcase>: every primitive, animated
Demo.Note: Move the pointer over it: the red disc follows on a wobbly spring.

Demo.Title: <SketchPad>: draw on it
Demo.Note: Mouse, trackpad or pen. The strokes are kept as points and drawn as lines with round caps.

Demo.Title: The code
Demo.Note: A custom widget in C: measure, paint, events. Then Rxml_register_tag makes it a tag of the XML.
